title: Croatian Pasta Bake
description: A delicious and easy-to-make vegetarian pasta bake with a creamy Croatian twist. Perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large pan, sauté the onion until softened.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the sour cream, grated cheese, and smoked Croatian cheese. Mix well.
Add the cooked pasta to the mixing bowl and toss with the cheesy sauce until coated.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and smooth out the top.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly.
